notes: Fixtures are generated by setup_fixtures.sh, not committed. Run pattern (skill-creator): one subagent per eval with the skill, one with a baseline snapshot (old SKILL.md); save each report to iteration-N/<eval>/<config>/outputs/review.md; grade against the assertions below with text/passed/evidence.

evals.name: eval-0-billing
evals.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this repo before I commit. I refactored the billing helpers and want to be sure nothing broke.
evals.expected_output: SQL injection in search_invoices, off-by-one pagination in list_invoices, and the swallowed exception / dropped positive-amount guard in process_refund are all flagged; verdict plus severity tags.
assertions: Flags the SQL injection in search_invoices (f-string interpolation of customer_id/status) as a must-fix/SEV.
Flags the off-by-one pagination in list_invoices (offset = page * per_page breaks the documented 1-based page 1 and fails test_first_page_is_1_based).
Flags process_refund swallowing exceptions and/or dropping the positive-amount guard (silent failure / negative refund).
Flags every planted defect (SQLi, pagination, refund error handling) at MED or higher.
Includes a verdict line (APPROVE / APPROVE WITH NITS / REQUEST CHANGES) and a severity tag per issue.
Does not fabricate critical issues: every SEV finding maps to a real defect in the diff.

evals.name: eval-1-auth
evals.prompt: Security pass on my uncommitted auth changes. Is this safe to ship?
evals.expected_output: Debug auth bypass, removed authorization check (IDOR), timing-unsafe comparison, logged secret, and predictable md5 token are all flagged; verdict plus severity tags.
assertions: Flags the debug bypass in verify_token (provided == 'debug' returns True).
Flags the removed authorization check in get_account (IDOR).
Flags the timing-unsafe comparison in verify_token (== instead of hmac.compare_digest).
Flags the logged TOKEN_SECRET (print to stdout/logs).
Flags the predictable, unsalted md5 token (no per-issue nonce).
Verdict + severity tags present; no fabricated SEVs.

evals.name: eval-2-perf
evals.prompt: A teammate changed our reporting helpers. Can you review the diff before I approve the PR? Watch for performance problems.
evals.expected_output: N+1 query in load_users, ZeroDivisionError on empty input in average, in-place sort mutating the caller's list in top_scores, and the unbounded loop in fetch_until_done are all flagged; verdict plus severity tags.
assertions: Flags the N+1 query in load_users (per-id query in a loop).
Flags ZeroDivisionError in average on empty input.
Flags the in-place sort mutating the caller's list in top_scores.
Flags the unbounded/infinite loop in fetch_until_done.
Flags every planted defect at MED or higher.
Verdict + severity tags present; no fabricated SEVs.

evals.name: eval-3-benign
evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes before I commit — I added some search helpers.
evals.expected_output: No SEV findings; the safe placeholder-building f-string, the non-secret == comparison, the local sorted(), and the specific except KeyError are not reported as defects; verdict APPROVE or APPROVE WITH NITS.
assertions: Flags no SEV issues: the safe IN (...) placeholder f-string (values bound), == on a non-secret label, the local sorted, and the specific except KeyError are NOT reported as security/correctness defects.
Does not invent defects: any findings are at most NIT/MED and correspond to the actual change (e.g. the unused MAX_IDS constant).
Verdict is APPROVE or APPROVE WITH NITS, not REQUEST CHANGES.

evals.name: eval-4-nodiff
evals.prompt: I'm about to commit my changes — can you review them first?
evals.expected_output: States there are no uncommitted or staged changes; no fabricated findings, no invented diff, no SEV for the empty change.
assertions: States there are no uncommitted or staged changes to review (or equivalent), rather than presenting committed history as if it were the requested change.
Does not fabricate findings or a diff: no invented defects attributed to the non-existent change.
Does not mark the absence of changes as a defect/SEV or answer REQUEST CHANGES for an empty change.

evals.name: eval-5-nitonly
evals.prompt: Quick review of my uncommitted diff before I commit?
evals.expected_output: Verdict APPROVE or APPROVE WITH NITS, no SEV, the O(n^2) dedupe flagged with stated impact, severity tags present.
assertions: Verdict is APPROVE or APPROVE WITH NITS, not REQUEST CHANGES.
Reports no SEV findings.
Flags the O(n^2) dedupe (item not in result inside a loop), graded MED or NIT with the impact stated (e.g. no callers / large inputs only).
Tags issues with a severity (SEV/MED/NIT).

evals.name: eval-6-projectrules
evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the project's declared review conventions (.agents/skills/project-review + docs/STYLE.md) and applies them: output starts with PROJECT REVIEW, uses BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR severity codes, and cites the style rule for the bare except.
assertions: Follows the project review conventions: output starts with `PROJECT REVIEW` (or clearly adopts the project's format) and uses BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR severity codes rather than SEV/MED/NIT.
Flags the bare `except:` in the change.
Cites the project's style rule (a Conventions line / reference to docs/STYLE.md) rather than only generic advice.
No fabricated SEVs: findings map to the change.
